integrity: Analytic proof establishes asymptotic and moment frontier; reproducibility code supplies non-exhaustive finite identity and Monte Carlo corroboration, never infinite certification. Literature search is not a proof of universal novelty; no independent audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: One exact entry-square RPLU pivot; fixed finite rectangular real matrices at least 2 by 2; independent Gaussian perturbations of any fixed positive variance; centered closed form requires zero deterministic mean. No multi-step or finite-precision result. The moment divergence averages jointly over noisy matrices and pivot selections, not over pivots alone for fixed input. Classical exact second-moment identity is explicitly credited.
title: Universal cubic Pareto tails for Gaussian-smoothed squared-pivot randomized LU
